paper.authors: Sami Yamani Douzi Sorkhabi and David A. Romero and Gary Kai Yan and Michelle Dao Gu and Joaquin Moran and Michael Morgenroth and Cristina H. Amon
paper.title: The Impact of Land Use Constraints in Multi-Objective Energy-Noise Wind Farm Layout Optimization

same_lineage_public_assets.role: independent ISO 9613 formula cross-check inherited from T72

paper_source_conflicts: The paper maximizes AEP but printed static and dynamic AEP penalty equations add a positive penalty; the implementation minimizes negative AEP plus positive penalties.
The printed regulatory-distance equation and extracted inequality are dimensionally ambiguous at polygon boundaries; the reconstruction uses Euclidean sampled distance to available land.
The paper says each optimization is carried out five times, while merged C1/C2 timing tables report ten runs; the platform keeps each parameterization separate and uses 25 independent seeds.
missing_information: author in-house C++ source, executable environment, and random states
225 native random polygon vertices, forbidden identities, and receptor coordinates
complete octave spectra, atmospheric, ground, and receptor constants
NSGA-II distribution indices and offspring count
completion_decisions: Reuse the independently H5-validated same-lineage T72 Jensen, wind-state, ISO propagation, land, and NSGA-II components without changing default T72 semantics; select the paper's 0.3u^3 kW and constant Lw=100 dB T64 profile.
Generate deterministic similar-area jittered-Voronoi maps with one receptor at each forbidden seed.
Reconstruct 24 directions by 43 speeds from the cited Kusiak lineage and use standard full Jensen deficits.
Use the pinned-PyWake-checked T72 ISO constants, Deb-standard eta_c=eta_m=20, and offspring size equal to population.
Use counter-keyed feasible construction sequentially within each layout and parallel across population members.
Count an infeasible death layout and its feasible replacement as two complete physical evaluations.
Generate four deterministic map variants for the missing native uniformity arrays.
Reproduce static C1/C2, dynamic C1/C2, and death as target methods; do not add unrelated paper comparator baselines.

scope.claim_boundary: academic flexible paper/lineage reconstruction of all target constraint modes and thirteen paper roles; not author code native arrays original random stream raw fronts or numerical replay

decision_variables.resolution: 2N continuous turbine x-y coordinates in a 3 km square

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: real-valued NSGA-II coordinates with direct physical decoding

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize AEP and minimize maximum expected receptor SPL, implemented as minimize negative AEP and SPL with positive penalties

constraints_and_repair.resolution: minimum 385 m spacing and no turbine in forbidden polygons; static/dynamic penalize squared violation and death physically rejects and replaces

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Jensen top-hat full deficit, RSS wake superposition, the paper's 0.3u^3 kW then 1.5 MW power curve, constant Lw=100 dB, and ISO-9613 expected maximum A-weighted SPL

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: 24 direction bins and 43 speeds from 4 to 25 m/s in 0.5 m/s steps using a direction-conditioned truncated Weibull reconstruction

initialization.resolution: random feasible layouts using counter-keyed rejection sampling, sequential within layout and population-parallel

update_order.resolution: binary tournament, SBX, polynomial mutation, selected penalty mode, stable rank/crowding environmental selection, ordered generation commit

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: at most 80000 complete layout evaluations for static/dynamic and 40000 for death preliminary work, or last-100 rank-one crowding variance below 0.005

parameters.resolution: population 200/150/100, crossover 0.95, mutation 0.05, eta_c=eta_m=20, static 1e4/4e4 and dynamic Cgen=ngen/ngen-over-2

paper_native_cases.resolution: nine main land-availability by turbine-count cases plus four 80-percent, 10-turbine uniformity roles; 13 roles and 12 unique reconstructed instances

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: per-run Pareto fronts, AEP/SPL range, front cardinality, convergence, physical FES, uniformity, timings, workers, and hashes over 25 platform seeds per parameterization
